patch:
diff --git a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
index 55fa844..19874bc 100644
--- a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
+++ b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
@@ -6,6 +6,6 @@ def orders_for_customer(customer):
     rows = []
     for order in ORDERS:
         owner = next(c for c in CUSTOMERS if c["id"] == order["customer_id"])
-        if owner["name"] == customer["name"]:
+        if owner["id"] == customer["id"]:
             rows.append(order)
     return rows
verification: run_tests.py -> visible tests passed. Duplicate check: before fix 101/102 each twice; after fix every order exactly once. Report: 4 lines as expected. Totals: 290 before, 165 after. Cross-customer billing verified per customer.
cause: orders_for_customer compared customer names (owner['name'] == customer['name']); two distinct 'Acme' customers each received both customers' orders, duplicating lines and inflating totals. Fix compares ids (owner['id'] == customer['id']).
